Combining high-octane racing with the luxury of a marbella yacht charter f1 grand prix 2036 experience offers an unforgettable getaway. This itinerary guides you through a perfect weekend, from race-day viewing on the water to evening celebrations in Puerto Banús. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks—no hidden costs.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for F1 Weekend?

Watching the F1 Grand Prix from a yacht adds a layer of exclusivity and comfort. You avoid crowded bars and enjoy panoramic views of the Mediterranean. Our fleet ranges from the Marbella yacht charter Dubhe (5 pax) to the Ferretti 94 (12 pax), so there's a boat for every group size. The atmosphere in Puerto Banús during F1 weekend is electric, with fans gathering at beach clubs and restaurants. A charter lets you combine race viewing with swimming, jet skiing, and coastal exploration.

Friday: Arrival and Evening in Puerto Banús

Arrive in Marbella and check into your accommodation along the Golden Mile. Spend the afternoon exploring Puerto Banús, where superyachts line the marina. For dinner, book a table at a waterfront restaurant like Bibo or Purobeach. If you want a pre-race taster, consider a sunset cruise on the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) to see the coast from the sea. The 12.5m boat accommodates 9 guests and includes drinks and snacks.

Saturday: Race Day – Viewing from the Water

On race day, depart from Puerto Banús at 10:00 on your chosen yacht. For groups of 10, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) is ideal at €749/2h. If you want extra thrills, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski. Anchor near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where you can stream the race live on board. Many yachts have large screens and sound systems. Enjoy the race with cold beers, cava, and light snacks—all included. After the race, cruise back to Puerto Banús for evening festivities.

Sunday: Relaxed Coastal Cruise and Departure

Sunday is for unwinding. Charter a boat for a half-day cruise to Cabopino or Estepona. The Bandido (8 pax) is a great choice for smaller groups at 11.5m. Swim in crystal-clear waters, use the paddleboard if available, and enjoy a final Spanish lunch at a chiringuito. Return to Puerto Banús by 17:00 to catch your flight or extend your stay. This day is flexible—your skipper can tailor the route to your preferences.
